#
# backends/c/tests — W3C SCXML conformance harness for the C11 backend
# (RFC §5.J.1, downstream consumer).
#
# Sibling of `tests/` (the C++ AOT/Interpreter harness). C11 code is
# generated by `sce-codegen -l c11` into ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/
# generated/, then linked together with the per-fixture runner in
# `aot_tests/test_<NUM>.c` to produce one CTest binary per fixture.
#
# Per-fixture runners are intentionally minimal — `int main(void)`
# returning 0 on PASS and 1 on FAIL — because the C11 backend cannot
# pull in GoogleTest the way the C++ harness does. CTest treats the
# binary's exit status as the verdict, which is enough for AOT-only
# conformance (no in-test fixtures, no parametrised cases).

include(${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake/SCEStaticW3CTest.cmake)
# Parallel CMake function for integration fixtures
# (`integration_resources/<stem>/<stem>.scxml` → `<output>/<stem>_sm.{h,c}`).
include(${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake/SCEStaticIntegrationFixture.cmake)

set(SCE_C_GENERATED_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated")
file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${SCE_C_GENERATED_DIR}")

# Output dir for c11 integration-fixture codegen. Distinct from the
# W3C dir so build-system stale-tree detection treats W3C and integration
# trees as separate §6.2.6 drift contexts (RFC Q-2 parallel).
set(SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/integration_generated")
file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}")

# sce_c_integration_generation(<PREFIX> <document> [<sce_codegen_generation option>...])
#
#   One generation of <document> into the integration directory, declared
#   from its plan (`sce_codegen_generation`, cmake/SCECodegenPlan.cmake): the
#   files its command produces, its depfile and what it requires are the
#   generator's answer, and nothing about them is written here. It claims in
#   the list the integration fixtures claim in, so a file a fixture's
#   generation writes into the same directory is that generation's. Sets
#   <PREFIX>_HEADERS and <PREFIX>_SOURCES, as generator expressions a target's
#   sources take.
function(sce_c_integration_generation PREFIX DOCUMENT)
    sce_codegen_generation(_GENERATION
        DOCUMENT "${DOCUMENT}"
        OUTPUT_DIR "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}"
        LANGUAGE c11
        CLAIM SCE_C_INTEGRATION_DECLARED_OUTPUTS
        ${ARGN})
    set(${PREFIX}_HEADERS "${_GENERATION_HEADERS}" PARENT_SCOPE)
    set(${PREFIX}_SOURCES "${_GENERATION_SOURCES}" PARENT_SCOPE)
endfunction()

# ── The W3C conformance suite on the C11 backend ────────────────────
#
# Every fixture the conformance registry (tests/w3c/conformance/fixtures.json)
# lists, in registry order, generated with `sce-codegen -l c11` and compiled
# with its runner `aot_tests/test_<id>.c` into one CTest binary. The ids, and
# the harness each one names, are read through the one reading of the
# registry the C++ route shares (`sce_w3c_registry_fixtures`,
# cmake/SCEW3CRegistry.cmake): registering a fixture is its registry entry
# and its runner, and no id is written here.
#
# What each binary links beside its runner is what the generator states the
# fixture's machines require (`W3C_C_AOT_TEST_<id>_REQUIRES`), mapped onto the
# libraries of backends/c/runtime that implement it (`sce_c_runtime_libraries`;
# see backends/c/runtime/CMakeLists.txt and ARCHITECTURE.md §"C11 backend
# layering"). Until 2026-11 this was 202 hand-written registrations, each
# flagged NEEDS_LUA, NEEDS_DOM or NEEDS_HTTP by hand: a second copy of the
# registry, in an order of its own, and a second copy of what the generator
# decides about each machine. What each registration's comment said about its
# fixture is in the fixture's runner.
set(W3C_C_AOT_TESTS "")
sce_w3c_registry_fixtures(_W3C_C_IDS _W3C_C_HARNESS_OF_)
foreach(_W3C_C_ID ${_W3C_C_IDS})
    sce_generate_static_w3c_c_test(${_W3C_C_ID} "${SCE_C_GENERATED_DIR}")
endforeach()

# Every fixture registered above is declared here, after its plan and every
# other one were asked of the generator in one batch
# (cmake/SCEStaticW3CTest.cmake), which sets W3C_C_AOT_TEST_<id>_SOURCES and
# W3C_C_AOT_TEST_<id>_REQUIRES for the loop below. A fixture registered below
# this line is refused.
sce_declare_registered_static_w3c_c_tests()

# One CTest binary per fixture. Compiled with the C11 dialect explicitly so
# `SCE_STATIC_ASSERT`'s C11 lowering and stdint/stdbool are first-class
# regardless of the compiler's default standard. A binary links what its
# fixture's machines require and nothing else (`sce_c_link_runtime`), so a
# machine with no data model keeps the MCU-relevant zero-deps profile: it
# links neither Lua nor the DOM binding.
#
# Every runner is a host program that may time its own run (the scheduled
# ones poll `_sce_clock_now_ms` against a deadline), so each requires the
# platform clock beside what its machines require. A configuration that
# builds no platform tier, or no script engine, leaves out every runner that
# requires what it does not build; a bare-metal consumer opting out still
# gets the freestanding forge and EventSchema fixtures below.
set(W3C_C_AOT_HTTP_TESTS "")
set(_sce_c_w3c_unlinkable "")
foreach(TEST_NUM ${W3C_C_AOT_TESTS})
        # What the fixture's machines require, as the generator stated it, and
        # what the runner itself requires. A requirement whose tier this
        # configuration does not build (`lua` and `dom` without
        # SCE_ENABLE_LUA, `clock` without SCE_C_RUNTIME_POSIX) leaves the
        # fixture out, since it cannot be linked here, and the datamodel-less
        # fixtures still run without a script engine.
        sce_c_runtime_libraries(_libraries _unmet
            ${W3C_C_AOT_TEST_${TEST_NUM}_REQUIRES} clock)
        if(NOT "${_unmet}" STREQUAL "")
            string(REPLACE ";" " " _unmet_text "${_unmet}")
            list(APPEND _sce_c_w3c_unlinkable "${TEST_NUM} (${_unmet_text})")
            continue()
        endif()
        # How the fixture is run is its registry harness: `http` needs the
        # W3C HTTP endpoint listening, `scheduled` and `simple` need nothing
        # of the build, since every runner drives its machine to completion
        # itself. A harness this list does not know is refused here rather
        # than run as the wrong one.
        set(_harness "${_W3C_C_HARNESS_OF_${TEST_NUM}}")
        if(NOT _harness STREQUAL "simple" AND NOT _harness STREQUAL "scheduled"
           AND NOT _harness STREQUAL "http")
            message(FATAL_ERROR
                "W3C test ${TEST_NUM} names the harness `${_harness}`, which the C11 "
                "route does not run: say here what its runner needs")
        endif()
        set(_runner "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/aot_tests/test_${TEST_NUM}.c")
        set(_target "sce_c_w3c_test_${TEST_NUM}")
        # Every translation unit and header the fixture's generations write:
        # its machine and, W3C SCXML 6.4, the machine of every child it starts.
        # The list is the generator's answer (`sce_generate_static_w3c_c_test`),
        # so no file of it is named here.
        add_executable(${_target} ${_runner} ${W3C_C_AOT_TEST_${TEST_NUM}_SOURCES})
        sce_c_link_runtime(${_target} REQUIRES clock)
        # `tests/w3c` carries the ONE owner of the BasicHTTP fixture endpoint
        # (`basic_http_test_endpoint.h`, a C11 header for exactly this reason).
        # Without it in reach each BasicHTTP runner writes the address again,
        # which is how one fact came to be spelled in five places.
        target_include_directories(${_target} PRIVATE
            "${SCE_C_GENERATED_DIR}"
            "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/w3c")
        set_target_properties(${_target} PROPERTIES
            C_STANDARD 11
            C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON
            C_EXTENSIONS OFF
        )

        add_test(NAME w3c_c_aot_${TEST_NUM} COMMAND ${_target})
        set_tests_properties(w3c_c_aot_${TEST_NUM} PROPERTIES
            TIMEOUT 30
            LABELS "w3c;c11;aot"
        )
        if(_harness STREQUAL "http")
            # The runner reads the endpoint from the environment at run time
            # (basic_http_test_endpoint.h), so the tree's configured port has
            # to reach it here. Without this the fixture would bind the
            # configured port while the machine published the header default,
            # and the fixture would fail on any tree that moved the port.
            set_tests_properties(w3c_c_aot_${TEST_NUM} PROPERTIES
                FIXTURES_REQUIRED w3c_c_http_server
                ENVIRONMENT "SCE_W3C_HTTP_PORT=${SCE_W3C_HTTP_PORT}"
            )
            list(APPEND W3C_C_AOT_HTTP_TESTS ${TEST_NUM})
        endif()
endforeach()
if(NOT "${_sce_c_w3c_unlinkable}" STREQUAL "")
    list(LENGTH _sce_c_w3c_unlinkable _sce_c_w3c_skipped)
    string(REPLACE ";" ", " _sce_c_w3c_unlinkable_text "${_sce_c_w3c_unlinkable}")
    message(STATUS
        "Skipping ${_sce_c_w3c_skipped} W3C C11 conformance runner(s) that require "
        "what this configuration does not build: ${_sce_c_w3c_unlinkable_text}")
endif()

# Each program below links what the machines it compiles require
# (`sce_c_link_runtime`), and most of those machines embed the Lua engine or
# schedule on the platform clock: the block is bounded by the two options
# that build those tiers, since `sce_c_link_runtime` refuses a program whose
# machines require a tier this configuration does not build.
if(SCE_C_RUNTIME_POSIX AND SCE_ENABLE_LUA)
    # ─── Integration fixtures ────────────────────────────────────────────
    #
    # Build-time generation under SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR (no
    # committed tree — the build is the §6.2.6 freshness invariant,
    # mirroring the cpp/c11 W3C IRP pattern). The fixture closes the W3C
    # IRP gap on `<donedata>` + `<invoke>` + `done.invoke.<id>._event.data`
    # (a grep against `resources/*/test*.txml` returned zero hits).
    sce_generate_static_integration_c_test(donedata_local_invoke "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}")

    add_executable(sce_c_integration_donedata_local_invoke
        integration/test_donedata_local_invoke.c
        ${INTEGRATION_C_TEST_donedata_local_invoke_SOURCES}
    )
    sce_c_link_runtime(sce_c_integration_donedata_local_invoke)
    target_include_directories(sce_c_integration_donedata_local_invoke PRIVATE
        "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}"
    )
    set_target_properties(sce_c_integration_donedata_local_invoke PROPERTIES
        C_STANDARD 11
        C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON
        C_EXTENSIONS OFF
    )
    add_test(NAME c11_integration_donedata_local_invoke
        COMMAND sce_c_integration_donedata_local_invoke
    )
    set_tests_properties(c11_integration_donedata_local_invoke PROPERTIES
        TIMEOUT 30
        LABELS "integration;c11;aot"
    )

    # W3C SCXML 6.4 autoforward field preservation. The IRP suite checks only
    # that the event name crosses (test229) or leaves the field comparison to a
    # human (test230 is a manual test), so a name-only forward passes both; this
    # fixture asserts the copy is exact.
    sce_generate_static_integration_c_test(autoforward_event_fields "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}")

    add_executable(sce_c_integration_autoforward_event_fields
        integration/test_autoforward_event_fields.c
        ${INTEGRATION_C_TEST_autoforward_event_fields_SOURCES}
    )
    sce_c_link_runtime(sce_c_integration_autoforward_event_fields)
    target_include_directories(sce_c_integration_autoforward_event_fields PRIVATE
        "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}"
    )
    set_target_properties(sce_c_integration_autoforward_event_fields PROPERTIES
        C_STANDARD 11
        C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON
        C_EXTENSIONS OFF
    )
    add_test(NAME c11_integration_autoforward_event_fields
        COMMAND sce_c_integration_autoforward_event_fields
    )
    set_tests_properties(c11_integration_autoforward_event_fields PROPERTIES
        TIMEOUT 30
        LABELS "integration;c11;aot"
    )

    # W3C SCXML 6.4 + 5.10 + 3.12.1: the copy a parent autoforwards to its child
    # is told the name the event arrived under, whether the parent delivered it as
    # the member of a shorter descriptor or as the wildcard member. A document of
    # this channel alone, beside the C test: the parent reads the name of the
    # event its own member does not hold, which the shared stems drive no host to
    # send.
    sce_generate_static_integration_c_test(autoforward_keeps_the_arrival_name
        "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}"
        SCXML_FILE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/integration_resources/autoforward_keeps_the_arrival_name/autoforward_keeps_the_arrival_name.scxml"
    )
    add_executable(sce_c_integration_autoforward_keeps_the_arrival_name
        integration/test_autoforward_keeps_the_arrival_name.c
        ${INTEGRATION_C_TEST_autoforward_keeps_the_arrival_name_SOURCES}
    )
    sce_c_link_runtime(sce_c_integration_autoforward_keeps_the_arrival_name)
    target_include_directories(sce_c_integration_autoforward_keeps_the_arrival_name PRIVATE
        "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}"
    )
    set_target_properties(sce_c_integration_autoforward_keeps_the_arrival_name PROPERTIES
        C_STANDARD 11
        C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON
        C_EXTENSIONS OFF
    )
    add_test(NAME c11_integration_autoforward_keeps_the_arrival_name
        COMMAND sce_c_integration_autoforward_keeps_the_arrival_name
    )
    set_tests_properties(c11_integration_autoforward_keeps_the_arrival_name PROPERTIES
        TIMEOUT 30
        LABELS "integration;c11;aot"
    )

    # docs/adr/0086, section 8.6 (c): the data of an event a host hands by name,
    # which the document declares no schema for, is bounded by the host ABI
    # (SCE_UNTYPED_EVENT_DATA_MAX_LEN): a machine with no script engine keeps that
    # much, and refuses whole, counted and named, data past its slot. A document
    # of this channel alone, beside the C test: no other channel holds an event's
    # data in storage the build sizes. The driver reads the slot's size from the
    # generated header, so it holds whatever floor the build gives the slot.
    sce_generate_static_integration_c_test(untyped_data_by_name
        "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}"
        SCXML_FILE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/integration_resources/untyped_data_by_name/untyped_data_by_name.scxml"
    )
    add_executable(sce_c_integration_untyped_data_by_name
        integration/test_untyped_data_by_name.c
        ${INTEGRATION_C_TEST_untyped_data_by_name_SOURCES}
    )
    sce_c_link_runtime(sce_c_integration_untyped_data_by_name)
    target_include_directories(sce_c_integration_untyped_data_by_name PRIVATE
        "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}"
    )
    set_target_properties(sce_c_integration_untyped_data_by_name PROPERTIES
        C_STANDARD 11
        C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON
        C_EXTENSIONS OFF
    )
    add_test(NAME c11_integration_untyped_data_by_name
        COMMAND sce_c_integration_untyped_data_by_name
    )
    set_tests_properties(c11_integration_untyped_data_by_name PROPERTIES
        TIMEOUT 30
        LABELS "integration;c11;aot"
    )

    # W3C SCXML 5.10 + 3.12.1: `_event.name` is the name an event arrived under,
    # and a transition on `request` takes `request.new` whether or not the
    # document writes it. The IRP corpus never reads a name the document does not
    # write.
    sce_generate_static_integration_c_test(an_event_keeps_the_name_it_was_sent_under "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}")

    add_executable(sce_c_integration_an_event_keeps_the_name_it_was_sent_under
        integration/test_an_event_keeps_the_name_it_was_sent_under.c
        ${INTEGRATION_C_TEST_an_event_keeps_the_name_it_was_sent_under_SOURCES}
    )
    sce_c_link_runtime(sce_c_integration_an_event_keeps_the_name_it_was_sent_under)
    target_include_directories(sce_c_integration_an_event_keeps_the_name_it_was_sent_under PRIVATE
        "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}"
    )
    set_target_properties(sce_c_integration_an_event_keeps_the_name_it_was_sent_under PROPERTIES
        C_STANDARD 11
        C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON
        C_EXTENSIONS OFF
    )
    add_test(NAME c11_integration_an_event_keeps_the_name_it_was_sent_under
        COMMAND sce_c_integration_an_event_keeps_the_name_it_was_sent_under
    )
    set_tests_properties(c11_integration_an_event_keeps_the_name_it_was_sent_under PROPERTIES
        TIMEOUT 30
        LABELS "integration;c11;aot"
    )

    # W3C SCXML 3.12.1 + 5.10: a `<send eventexpr>` computes its event's name, so
    # the document cannot have written it; a transition on `request` takes
    # `request.new`, `*` takes the rest, and `_event.name` is the whole name — over
    # the external and the internal queue, now and after a delay.
    #
    # This document declares its transitions as constant data
    # (`sce:transition-table="emit"`): nothing here reads the table, and the build
    # of this channel is what proves it compiles. Its wildcard transitions and its
    # several events are the shapes of an entry that has no single id.
    sce_generate_static_integration_c_test(a_computed_event_name_is_matched_like_any_other "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}")

    add_executable(sce_c_integration_a_computed_event_name_is_matched_like_any_other
        integration/test_a_computed_event_name_is_matched_like_any_other.c
        ${INTEGRATION_C_TEST_a_computed_event_name_is_matched_like_any_other_SOURCES}
    )
    sce_c_link_runtime(sce_c_integration_a_computed_event_name_is_matched_like_any_other)
    target_include_directories(sce_c_integration_a_computed_event_name_is_matched_like_any_other PRIVATE
        "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}"
    )
    set_target_properties(sce_c_integration_a_computed_event_name_is_matched_like_any_other PROPERTIES
        C_STANDARD 11
        C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON
        C_EXTENSIONS OFF
    )
    add_test(NAME c11_integration_a_computed_event_name_is_matched_like_any_other
        COMMAND sce_c_integration_a_computed_event_name_is_matched_like_any_other
    )
    set_tests_properties(c11_integration_a_computed_event_name_is_matched_like_any_other PROPERTIES
        TIMEOUT 30
        LABELS "integration;c11;aot"
    )

    # docs/adr/0089: the same machine, built with its transition observer on.
    # The driver defines the hook the machine calls for each transition it takes
    # and holds what it is told to the machine's emitted transition table. The
    # target above builds the machine with the switch off and defines no hook,
    # which links only because nothing of the observer is left in it.
    add_executable(sce_c_integration_transition_observer
        integration/test_transition_observer.c
        ${INTEGRATION_C_TEST_a_computed_event_name_is_matched_like_any_other_SOURCES}
    )
    target_compile_definitions(sce_c_integration_transition_observer PRIVATE
        SCE_TRANSITION_OBSERVER=1
    )
    sce_c_link_runtime(sce_c_integration_transition_observer)
    target_include_directories(sce_c_integration_transition_observer PRIVATE
        "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}"
    )
    set_target_properties(sce_c_integration_transition_observer PROPERTIES
        C_STANDARD 11
        C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON
        C_EXTENSIONS OFF
    )
    add_test(NAME c11_integration_transition_observer
        COMMAND sce_c_integration_transition_observer
    )
    set_tests_properties(c11_integration_transition_observer PROPERTIES
        TIMEOUT 30
        LABELS "integration;c11;aot"
    )

    # SCE Accepted Subset 2.21: a document that declares its transition function
    # (`sce:transition-function="emit"`) is generated with a header of its own
    # beside the machine, `<stem>_transition_function.h`, every symbol under a
    # prefix no symbol of the machine begins with. Each driver includes both in
    # one translation unit and holds the machine to the function on every
    # (state, event) pair. A flat cycle, and a nested lifecycle that reaches every
    # selection rule the function is computed by.
    sce_generate_static_integration_c_test(flat_lifecycle "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}")

    add_executable(sce_c_integration_flat_lifecycle
        integration/test_flat_lifecycle.c
        ${INTEGRATION_C_TEST_flat_lifecycle_SOURCES}
    )
    sce_c_link_runtime(sce_c_integration_flat_lifecycle)
    target_include_directories(sce_c_integration_flat_lifecycle PRIVATE
        "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}"
    )
    set_target_properties(sce_c_integration_flat_lifecycle PROPERTIES
        C_STANDARD 11
        C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON
        C_EXTENSIONS OFF
    )
    add_test(NAME c11_integration_flat_lifecycle
        COMMAND sce_c_integration_flat_lifecycle
    )
    set_tests_properties(c11_integration_flat_lifecycle PROPERTIES
        TIMEOUT 30
        LABELS "integration;c11;aot"
    )

    sce_generate_static_integration_c_test(nested_lifecycle "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}")

    add_executable(sce_c_integration_nested_lifecycle
        integration/test_nested_lifecycle.c
        ${INTEGRATION_C_TEST_nested_lifecycle_SOURCES}
    )
    sce_c_link_runtime(sce_c_integration_nested_lifecycle)
    target_include_directories(sce_c_integration_nested_lifecycle PRIVATE
        "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}"
    )
    set_target_properties(sce_c_integration_nested_lifecycle PROPERTIES
        C_STANDARD 11
        C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON
        C_EXTENSIONS OFF
    )
    add_test(NAME c11_integration_nested_lifecycle
        COMMAND sce_c_integration_nested_lifecycle
    )
    set_tests_properties(c11_integration_nested_lifecycle PROPERTIES
        TIMEOUT 30
        LABELS "integration;c11;aot"
    )

    # W3C SCXML 6.4 autoforward carries `done.invoke.<id>`. Appendix D
    # `mainEventLoop` forwards every event dequeued from the external queue to each
    # autoforward child and excludes only the cancel event; §6.4.2 puts
    # `done.invoke.<id>` on that queue. Observing it needs two concurrent invokes,
    # which is why no IRP test covers it.
    sce_generate_static_integration_c_test(autoforward_done_invoke "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}")

    add_executable(sce_c_integration_autoforward_done_invoke
        integration/test_autoforward_done_invoke.c
        ${INTEGRATION_C_TEST_autoforward_done_invoke_SOURCES}
    )
    sce_c_link_runtime(sce_c_integration_autoforward_done_invoke)
    target_include_directories(sce_c_integration_autoforward_done_invoke PRIVATE
        "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}"
    )
    set_target_properties(sce_c_integration_autoforward_done_invoke PROPERTIES
        C_STANDARD 11
        C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON
        C_EXTENSIONS OFF
    )
    add_test(NAME c11_integration_autoforward_done_invoke
        COMMAND sce_c_integration_autoforward_done_invoke
    )
    set_tests_properties(c11_integration_autoforward_done_invoke PROPERTIES
        TIMEOUT 30
        LABELS "integration;c11;aot"
    )

    # W3C SCXML 6.4: the negative half of the same loop. The internal drain has
    # no forwarding step, so `error.execution` (6.2, unsupported `<send>` type)
    # must never reach an autoforward child — excluded by the queue it was
    # raised onto, not by a filter that recognises its name.
    sce_generate_static_integration_c_test(autoforward_internal_queue "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}")

    add_executable(sce_c_integration_autoforward_internal_queue
        integration/test_autoforward_internal_queue.c
        ${INTEGRATION_C_TEST_autoforward_internal_queue_SOURCES}
    )

    # W3C SCXML 6.4: *where* in the loop the forward happens. Appendix D puts it
    # one statement after `externalQueue.dequeue()`, and 6.4.2 in prose at the
    # point at which the parent removes the event from the external event queue.
    # The two fixtures above are blind to this by construction — queue order
    # alone cannot tell the enqueue from the dequeue, so the parent marks the
    # child directly with `<send target="#_inv_probe">` from a transition body.
    sce_generate_static_integration_c_test(autoforward_dequeue_point "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}")

    add_executable(sce_c_integration_autoforward_dequeue_point

    # W3C SCXML Appendix D: *when* the invokes start relative to the external
    # dequeue. mainEventLoop completes the macrostep on eventless and internal
    # transitions alone, runs invoke(inv), and only then reaches
    # externalQueue.dequeue(). The fixture above cannot see this axis — its child
    # opens the exchange, so it is alive before anything is queued; here the
    # parent queues for itself in onentry and the child starts second.
    sce_generate_static_integration_c_test(invoke_precedes_external_dequeue "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}")

    add_executable(sce_c_integration_invoke_precedes_external_dequeue

    # W3C SCXML Appendix D: the same order, reached mid-run. statesToInvoke is
    # filled by enterStates inside microstep, so a state entered by an external
    # event's transition arms an invoke that must start before the next event is

    # cannot see an engine that drains the external queue to exhaustion per step.

    # W3C SCXML 6.2 + 6.3: <cancel> drops a delayed <send> that has not been
    # dispatched, and a host that ticks after two fire times have passed must
    # still see them dispatched one macrostep apart. Draining the scheduled
    # queue to exhaustion first makes the later entry undroppable before the
    # earlier one's transitions have run, so the cancel executes against a
    # queue the event has already left.

    # W3C SCXML 3.1.2: an event no transition matches is discarded, and the host

    # W3C SCXML B.2.8.1: a payload that announced structure and that the

    # which is what the clause requires and is indistinguishable, from inside

    # W3C SCXML 3.13 + Appendix D: an event handed to a machine that has already
    # reached a top-level final state is refused, and the host cannot tell that

    # its queues are fixed-size arrays, so a host that keeps feeding a halted

    # W3C SCXML 5.3: typed readers of `<data>` ids that are keywords or no

    # W3C SCXML C.2 + 6.2.3: a `<send namelist>` that crosses BasicHTTP. The
    # IRP corpus states both claims and measures neither — test518's verdict is
    # `<transition event="test" target="pass"/>`, which passes on arrival
    # whatever the form carried, and no IRP document reads a namelist back out
    # of an HTTP payload at all. This backend answered the discard clause twice:
    # the SCXMLEventProcessor arm with `send_payload_json`'s declared-guard
    # (right, and witnessed by test553) and the BasicHTTP arm through the
    # ECMAScript frontend, which refused the document instead of raising
    # `error.execution` at run time. test553 declares no `<data>`, so the
    # frontend stayed silent on it and the split survived.
    sce_generate_static_integration_c_test(send_namelist_over_http "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}")

    add_executable(sce_c_integration_send_namelist_over_http

        ${INTEGRATION_C_TEST_send_namelist_over_http_SOURCES}

    sce_c_link_runtime(sce_c_integration_send_namelist_over_http)
    # `tests/w3c` carries the ONE owner of the BasicHTTP fixture endpoint
    # (`basic_http_test_endpoint.h`), the same reason the W3C C arm above
    # names it: this test publishes that address and must not spell it again.
    target_include_directories(sce_c_integration_send_namelist_over_http PRIVATE
        "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}"
        "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/w3c"

        C_STANDARD 11

        C_EXTENSIONS OFF

    # `_init_with_basic_http` publishes, so bind address and published address

    # W3C SCXML 3.12.2: the processor raises its own failures as `error.*` on the
    # internal queue, and the clause says they are ignored when nothing matches
    # them. Ignoring them is the clause; being unable to say it happened is not.
    # The sibling above stops at the external queue because an author's unmatched
    # <raise> has both ends inside the document; an error event's sender is the
    # engine, so that reasoning does not reach it. This backend answers the
    # membership question with a generated enum comparison — it has no
    # event-name table to consult at run time.
    sce_generate_static_integration_c_test(unhandled_error_is_observable "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}")

    # W3C SCXML 3.12.2 from the other side: the clause bounds what happens to an
    # error nobody answers, and says nothing about one a handler DOES answer
    # with the same failure every time. The failure raises the error, the same
    # transition answers it, and the drain never empties — measured 2026-08-19
    # at 37,000 links a second with the configuration unmoved, which is what an
    # unattended supervisor reads as a healthy idle machine.
    # W3C SCXML 3.13: a macrostep ends in a configuration where nothing is
    # enabled by NULL, and Appendix D's Principles and Constraints say that
    # chain need not exist. The ceiling is this engine declining a document the
    # specification allows, so the decline is published rather than silent.
    sce_generate_static_integration_c_test(eventless_macrostep_is_bounded "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}")

        TIMEOUT 30
        LABELS "integration;c11;aot"
    )

    # W3C SCXML Appendix D's inner loop returns to selectEventlessTransitions()
    # after every microstep and drains the internal queue there, without asking
    # whether the microstep moved the machine — W3C SCXML 3.13 defines a

    # W3C SCXML 3.12.1: `wild`, `wild.` and `wild.*` are "functionally
    # equivalent", and a bare `.*` is an empty token prefix that matches every
    # event. Each case is positive polarity because the four W3C documents that
    # write a bare `.*` write it as a catch-all to fail, which an engine
    # matching nothing on `.*` passes by never taking that transition.
    sce_generate_static_integration_c_test(event_descriptor_spellings_agree "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}")

    # W3C SCXML 3.12.1 + 3.13: a wildcard matches every event and changes

    # W3C SCXML 3.7: a <final> nested inside a compound state completes that

        C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON
        C_EXTENSIONS OFF
    )
    add_test(NAME c11_integration_nested_final_not_terminal
        COMMAND sce_c_integration_nested_final_not_terminal

        TIMEOUT 30
        LABELS "integration;c11;aot"
    )

    # W3C SCXML 3.4 + 3.7: a <parallel> completes when every region reaches a
    # <final>, and that raises done.state.<parallel>. A parallel owns no <final>
    # directly, so a rule registering the event by walking to a final's parent
    # never reaches it — while this backend's emitter raises it from the
    # grandparent. The generated code then named an undeclared enumerator, which
    # is a compile failure: building this target is most of the gate.
    sce_generate_static_integration_c_test(parallel_completion_raises_done_state "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}")

    add_executable(sce_c_integration_parallel_completion_raises_done_state
        integration/test_parallel_completion_raises_done_state.c
        ${INTEGRATION_C_TEST_parallel_completion_raises_done_state_SOURCES}
    )
    sce_c_link_runtime(sce_c_integration_parallel_completion_raises_done_state)
    target_include_directories(sce_c_integration_parallel_completion_raises_done_state PRIVATE
        "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}"
    )
    set_target_properties(sce_c_integration_parallel_completion_raises_done_state PROPERTIES
        C_STANDARD 11
        C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON
        C_EXTENSIONS OFF
    )
    add_test(NAME c11_integration_parallel_completion_raises_done_state
        COMMAND sce_c_integration_parallel_completion_raises_done_state
    )
    set_tests_properties(c11_integration_parallel_completion_raises_done_state PROPERTIES
        TIMEOUT 30
        LABELS "integration;c11;aot"
    )

    # W3C SCXML 3.4 + 3.7, the other half: declared is not delivered. The
    # fixture above carries no listener on purpose — a transition's `event`
    # attribute registers the name by itself, which would leave it unable to
    # fail — so what it proves is that this backend DECLARES the enumerator.
    # An emitter that names it and never raises it still compiles. This one
    # listens, and its verdict is a top-level <final> nothing else can reach.
    sce_generate_static_integration_c_test(parallel_done_state_is_delivered "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}")

    add_executable(sce_c_integration_parallel_done_state_is_delivered

    # W3C SCXML 3.4: one event can enable a transition in more than one region
    # of a <parallel>, and every such region takes its own in the same
    # microstep. The fixture is asymmetric on purpose — one region's transition
    # is an external self-transition, whose domain is a proper ancestor and
    # never the state itself; answering otherwise made the exit set name the
    # enclosing <parallel> and preempt the sibling region.
    sce_generate_static_integration_c_test(parallel_regions_take_own_transitions "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}")

    # W3C SCXML 3.4, the axis after the one above: a region that took an
    # external self-transition still holds an atomic state, so it answers the
    # NEXT event. The two are separate fixtures because the sibling's question
    # can be answered correctly by a configuration that is already broken —
    # measured 2026-08-14, the sibling's whole driver stays green under the
    # defect `parallel_microstep_owns_exit_and_entry.cases` restores while this
    # one goes red. What differs is which region the engine's current-state
    # pointer rests in, so the self-transitioning region is first in document
    # order here and second there.
    sce_generate_static_integration_c_test(parallel_self_transition_keeps_its_leaf "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}")

    # W3C SCXML Appendix D: `findLCCA` filters the source's PROPER ancestors
    # with `isCompoundStateOrScxmlElement`, so a `<parallel>` is never a
    # transition domain and an EXTERNAL transition written on a region root
    # resolves to the document root. `find_lcca` here returned the first proper
    # ancestor containing the target whatever its kind — `findLCA`, which the
    # appendix distinguishes from `findLCCA` — and the two answers differ only
    # when a `<parallel>` sits between the source and the first compound
    # `<state>` above it, which is exactly what a region root is.
    #
    # Named through SCXML_FILE rather than by stem: the document is shared
    # verbatim with the C++, Rust, Go and Python channels and lives beside its
    # C++ test, because a stem under `integration_resources/` is a
    # seven-channel commitment and the Kotlin channel has no witness here yet.
    sce_generate_static_integration_c_test(parallel_region_root_external_domain "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}"
        SCXML_FILE "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/integration/parallel_region_root_external_domain.scxml"
    )

    add_executable(sce_c_integration_parallel_region_root_external_domain
        integration/test_parallel_region_root_external_domain.c
        ${INTEGRATION_C_TEST_parallel_region_root_external_domain_SOURCES}
    )
    sce_c_link_runtime(sce_c_integration_parallel_region_root_external_domain)
    target_include_directories(sce_c_integration_parallel_region_root_external_domain PRIVATE
        "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}"
    )
    set_target_properties(sce_c_integration_parallel_region_root_external_domain PROPERTIES
        C_STANDARD 11
        C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON
        C_EXTENSIONS OFF
    )
    add_test(NAME c11_integration_parallel_region_root_external_domain
        COMMAND sce_c_integration_parallel_region_root_external_domain
    )
    set_tests_properties(c11_integration_parallel_region_root_external_domain PROPERTIES
        TIMEOUT 30
        LABELS "integration;c11;aot"
    )

    # A machine that answers an event by sending itself the next one never lets the
    # external queue empty, and every macrostep of it ends, so the microstep
    # ceiling never applies: the host call that drained it did not return. The
    # fixture holds every engine to one budget on external events
    # (ARCHITECTURE.md "External-Event Budget"). Named through SCXML_FILE rather
    # than by stem for the reason `scripts/regen_external_chain_is_bounded.sh`
    # states: a stem under `integration_resources/` is a seven-channel commitment.
    sce_generate_static_integration_c_test(external_chain_is_bounded "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}"
        SCXML_FILE "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/integration/external_chain_is_bounded.scxml"
    )

    add_executable(sce_c_integration_external_chain_is_bounded
        integration/test_external_chain_is_bounded.c
        ${INTEGRATION_C_TEST_external_chain_is_bounded_SOURCES}
    )
    # This backend bounds the delayed-send queue at SCE_MAX_SCHEDULED
    # (sce/types.h, 4 by default), its documented resource limit, and drops what
    # does not fit. The `timed` outcome arms all its pulses at once, so this one
    # target raises the bound to that many: what is measured is that a chain finite
    # because the clock is is not refused, not that four of the pulses fit. The
    # pulse count is the shared table's, read here so the bound cannot be moved
    # without the number it is sized for.
    # The budgets and counters the test holds the engine to are the shared
    # table's too, read at run time from this path.
    file(READ "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/external_event_budget/budget_outcomes.json" _SCE_BUDGET_TABLE)
    string(JSON _SCE_TIMED_PULSES ERROR_VARIABLE _SCE_TIMED_PULSES_ERR GET "${_SCE_BUDGET_TABLE}" timed pulses)
    if(_SCE_TIMED_PULSES_ERR)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "tests/external_event_budget/budget_outcomes.json has no timed.pulses: ${_SCE_TIMED_PULSES_ERR}")
    endif()
    target_compile_definitions(sce_c_integration_external_chain_is_bounded PRIVATE
        SCE_MAX_SCHEDULED=${_SCE_TIMED_PULSES}
        SCE_EXTERNAL_EVENT_BUDGET_TABLE="${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/external_event_budget/budget_outcomes.json"
    )
    sce_c_link_runtime(sce_c_integration_external_chain_is_bounded)
    target_include_directories(sce_c_integration_external_chain_is_bounded PRIVATE
        "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}"
    )
    set_target_properties(sce_c_integration_external_chain_is_bounded PROPERTIES
        C_STANDARD 11
        C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON
        C_EXTENSIONS OFF
    )
    add_test(NAME c11_integration_external_chain_is_bounded
        COMMAND sce_c_integration_external_chain_is_bounded
    )
    set_tests_properties(c11_integration_external_chain_is_bounded PROPERTIES
        TIMEOUT 30
        LABELS "integration;c11;aot"
    )

    # What ECMA-262 says an expression answers, measured against the Lua state a

    # W3C SCXML 3.3 + Appendix D: a compound state entered only because the

    # W3C SCXML 6.2.4 + C.2: a delay is a property of the send, not of the
    # processor it names — a delayed BasicHTTP send is POSTed when due, and
    # <cancel> reaches it while it waits. The runner is its own listener on
    # 127.0.0.1:18081 (the port the fixture's targets name), so what it checks
    # is the request the machine wrote on the wire.
    find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
    sce_generate_static_integration_c_test(a_delayed_http_send_is_posted_when_due "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}")

    )
    sce_c_link_runtime(sce_c_integration_a_delayed_http_send_is_posted_when_due)
    # The runner's own listener thread.
    target_link_libraries(sce_c_integration_a_delayed_http_send_is_posted_when_due PRIVATE
        Threads::Threads)
    target_include_directories(sce_c_integration_a_delayed_http_send_is_posted_when_due PRIVATE
        "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}"

        TIMEOUT 30
        LABELS "integration;c11;aot"

    # W3C SCXML 5.10 + B.2: the payload a HOST hands the machine has to reach

    # W3C SCXML B.2: a `<data>` element's XML content is "the corresponding DOM
    # structure" the appendix asks for, and a document walks it with DOM Level 1
    # Core's vocabulary. Measured 2026-08-18, every backend supplied three
    # methods instead — the two the W3C IRP suite reads plus a non-standard
    # `getTagName`. This channel is the one where the fixture is the ONLY
    # witness: `sce_lua_dom_push_object` and its metatable have no caller other
    # than generated code, so a unit test cannot reach them at all.
    sce_generate_static_integration_c_test(xml_data_is_a_dom_tree "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}")

    add_executable(sce_c_integration_xml_data_is_a_dom_tree
        integration/test_xml_data_is_a_dom_tree.c
        ${INTEGRATION_C_TEST_xml_data_is_a_dom_tree_SOURCES}
    )
    # sce_c_base carries the freestanding DOM parser and sce_c_scripting its
    # Lua binding — named here because this is the one integration fixture
    # whose `<data>` content is XML, which is what makes the generated
    # initializer call `sce_lua_dom_push_object` at all.
    sce_c_link_runtime(sce_c_integration_xml_data_is_a_dom_tree)
    target_include_directories(sce_c_integration_xml_data_is_a_dom_tree PRIVATE
        "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}"
    )
    set_target_properties(sce_c_integration_xml_data_is_a_dom_tree PROPERTIES
        C_STANDARD 11
        C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON
        C_EXTENSIONS OFF
    )

        COMMAND sce_c_integration_xml_data_is_a_dom_tree
    )
    set_tests_properties(c11_integration_xml_data_is_a_dom_tree PROPERTIES
        TIMEOUT 30
        LABELS "integration;c11;aot"

    # W3C SCXML 6.4.1: an <invoke> whose `type` names no processor this platform
    # implements is valid SCXML that must raise error.execution — not a document to
    # reject at build time. C11 reaches that raise through three gates the other
    # backends do not share (the entry-action switch, the scxml_family include
    # guards, and an execute_pending_invokes arm the `| scxml` filter skips), so
    # the fixture is the only thing that proves all three are open.
    # W3C SCXML 6.4.3: the expression a hybrid `<invoke>` names must be
    # evaluated at invoke-fire time, and a failure raises `error.execution`.
    # The stub child the parent spawns is declared because C11 #includes its
    # header from the parent translation unit.
    # W3C SCXML 6.4.3: the evaluated value selects among declared candidates.
    # C11 embeds each child by value, so both candidates are named here and
    # each gets a slot the parent guards with its own `_active` flag.
    sce_generate_static_integration_c_test(invoke_candidate_selects_the_child
        "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}")

    )
    set_target_properties(sce_c_integration_invoke_candidate_selects_the_child PROPERTIES

    # §scxml-6.2.5: a `<send type>` the HOST serves. The fixture lives beside
    # the build tests rather than under `integration_resources/` for the reason
    # `tests/CMakeLists.txt` gives on the C++ side: a stem there is a
    # seven-channel commitment, and the backends without a registry still
    # refuse the declaration by name. Named through SCXML_FILE for that reason.
    #
    # HOST_PROCESSOR is load-bearing, not decoration: codegen decides at
    # compile time whether a `<send type>` site dispatches or refuses, so the
    # test would register a handler against a machine built to refuse and read
    # as a feature that does not work.
    sce_generate_static_integration_c_test(statechart_host_processor
        "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}"
        SCXML_FILE "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/sce-build/tests/fixtures/host_processor/statechart_host_processor.scxml"
        HOST_PROCESSOR x-sce-host
    )

    # §scxml-G-7: `<sce:action>` native host dispatch, from the same document
    # the Rust, C++, Go, Kotlin and Python channels drive.
    #
    # No declaration flag here, unlike the host-processor registration above,
    # and that is the difference between the two seams rather than an omission:
    # a host-served `<send type>` is a build-time DECLARATION because the
    # document names a processor the platform may not have, while
    # `<sce:action>` names an operation the document itself declares — codegen
    # reads it from the element and emits the function-pointer vtable a host
    # must fill for `_init_with_actions` to accept it at all.
    #
    # Its machine must not require the script engine: this document's every
    # effect is a native action, so the machine has no `lua_State`. The link
    # excludes `lua` and `dom`, so the configure refuses the target the day the
    # generator states either — a better gate than a comment — and without them
    # the link is the proof.
    sce_generate_static_integration_c_test(statechart_native_action
        "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}"
        SCXML_FILE "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/sce-build/tests/fixtures/event_schema/statechart_native_action.scxml"
        # The arg-bearing action's types come from the EventSchema this
        # document imports; the staging copies one file, so without the
        # sibling the import resolves to nothing and codegen refuses the
        # arguments it can no longer type.
        STAGE_ALSO schema_fragment.scxml
    )

    add_executable(sce_c_integration_native_action
        integration/test_native_action.c
        ${INTEGRATION_C_TEST_statechart_native_action_SOURCES}
    )
    sce_c_link_runtime(sce_c_integration_native_action EXCLUDES lua dom)
    target_include_directories(sce_c_integration_native_action PRIVATE
        "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}"
    )
    set_target_properties(sce_c_integration_native_action PROPERTIES
        C_STANDARD 11
        C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON
        C_EXTENSIONS OFF
    )
    add_test(NAME c11_integration_native_action
        COMMAND sce_c_integration_native_action
    )
    set_tests_properties(c11_integration_native_action PROPERTIES
        TIMEOUT 30
        LABELS "integration;c11;aot"
    )

    # SCE Accepted Subset §2.15: `datamodel="sce-static"` under generated C —

    # docs/adr/0086, sections 5.2 and 6: the composed fixtures every backend whose
    # row of the one table of what is lowered reads a composed payload compiles and
    # runs (docs/SCE_ACCEPTED_SUBSET.md, "Which backend lowers a composed value"). The
    # first reads a payload of lists, records and optional values at depths 1 to 3,
    # the second forwards one to itself by the names of its parts; each reads the
    # schemas beside it.
    foreach(_STATIC_COMPOSED_MACHINE static_composed_payload static_composed_send)
        sce_generate_static_integration_c_test(${_STATIC_COMPOSED_MACHINE}
            "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}"
            SCXML_FILE "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/sce-build/tests/fixtures/static_datamodel/${_STATIC_COMPOSED_MACHINE}.scxml"
            STAGE_ALSO event_batch.scxml event_batch_item.scxml enum_signal_level.scxml event_counted.scxml
        )
    endforeach()
    foreach(_STATIC_COMPOSED_CASE a_composed_payload_is_read_at_any_depth:static_composed_payload
                                  a_composed_value_is_sent_by_its_name:static_composed_send)
        string(REPLACE ":" ";" _STATIC_COMPOSED_PARTS "${_STATIC_COMPOSED_CASE}")
        list(GET _STATIC_COMPOSED_PARTS 0 _STATIC_COMPOSED_TEST)
        list(GET _STATIC_COMPOSED_PARTS 1 _STATIC_COMPOSED_FIXTURE)
        add_executable(sce_c_integration_${_STATIC_COMPOSED_TEST}
            integration/test_${_STATIC_COMPOSED_TEST}.c
            ${INTEGRATION_C_TEST_${_STATIC_COMPOSED_FIXTURE}_SOURCES}
        )
        # No script engine: the link excludes `lua` and `dom`, so the configure
        # refuses the target the day the generator states either.
        sce_c_link_runtime(sce_c_integration_${_STATIC_COMPOSED_TEST} EXCLUDES lua dom)
        target_include_directories(sce_c_integration_${_STATIC_COMPOSED_TEST} PRIVATE
            "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}"
            "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/backends/c/forge-runtime/include"
        )
        set_target_properties(sce_c_integration_${_STATIC_COMPOSED_TEST} PROPERTIES
            C_STANDARD 11
            C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON
            C_EXTENSIONS OFF
        )
        add_test(NAME c11_integration_${_STATIC_COMPOSED_TEST}
            COMMAND sce_c_integration_${_STATIC_COMPOSED_TEST}
        )
        set_tests_properties(c11_integration_${_STATIC_COMPOSED_TEST} PROPERTIES
            TIMEOUT 30
            LABELS "integration;c11;aot"
        )
    endforeach()

        ${INTEGRATION_C_TEST_presence_peer_SOURCES}
        ${INTEGRATION_C_TEST_record_list_SOURCES}
        ${INTEGRATION_C_TEST_record_list_parent_SOURCES}
        ${_STATIC_SHARED_HEADERS}
        ${_STATIC_MERGE_HEADERS}
        ${_STATIC_EVENT_HEADERS}
        ${INTEGRATION_C_TEST_static_text_record_SOURCES}
        ${_STATIC_TEXT_HEADERS}
        ${INTEGRATION_C_TEST_static_lift_SOURCES}
    )
    sce_c_link_runtime(sce_c_integration_static_scalars EXCLUDES lua dom)
    target_include_directories(sce_c_integration_static_scalars PRIVATE
        "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}"
        "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/backends/c/forge-runtime/include"
    )
    # `static_invoke_optional` starts six children from one state. This backend bounds the
    # invokes a parent holds pending at SCE_MAX_INVOKES (sce/invoke.h, 4 by default), its
    # documented resource limit, and only generated code reads it, so this target raises
    # it above the fixture's six: what is measured is the value each child is handed, not
    # the default bound, past which a pending invoke is never started.
    target_compile_definitions(sce_c_integration_static_scalars PRIVATE
        SCE_STATIC_SCENARIO_DIR="${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/sce-build/tests/fixtures/static_datamodel/scenarios"
        SCE_MAX_INVOKES=8
    )
    set_target_properties(sce_c_integration_static_scalars PROPERTIES
        C_STANDARD 11
        C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON
        C_EXTENSIONS OFF
    )
    add_test(NAME c11_integration_static_scalars
        COMMAND sce_c_integration_static_scalars
    )
    set_tests_properties(c11_integration_static_scalars PROPERTIES
        TIMEOUT 30
        LABELS "integration;c11;aot"
    )

    # The shared to-do list at the bounds of a team (docs/adr/0082 §5): the document,
    # every document it imports and every algorithm they call, generated in one run with
    # the limits moved, into a directory of its own so that no header of the build above
    # is read in place of one of these. The program replays the scenarios the suite
    # above replays the same machine through, at the bounds its document writes.
    set(_LARGE_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/integration_generated_large")
    set(_LARGE_FIXTURES "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/sce-build/tests/fixtures/static_datamodel")
    file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${_LARGE_DIR}")
    sce_codegen_generation(_LARGE
        DOCUMENT "${_LARGE_FIXTURES}/todo_peer.scxml"
        OUTPUT_DIR "${_LARGE_DIR}"
        LANGUAGE c11
        INPUT_ROOT "${_LARGE_FIXTURES}"
        ARGS --with-imports
             --limit merge_values=65536 --limit merge_entries=65536
        COMMENT "Generating C11 todo_peer at the bounds of a team")
    add_executable(sce_c_integration_static_large
        integration/test_static_large.c
        ${_LARGE_SOURCES}
        ${_LARGE_HEADERS}
    )
    sce_c_link_runtime(sce_c_integration_static_large)
    target_include_directories(sce_c_integration_static_large PRIVATE
        "${_LARGE_DIR}"
        "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/backends/c/forge-runtime/include"
    )
    target_compile_definitions(sce_c_integration_static_large PRIVATE
        SCE_STATIC_SCENARIO_DIR="${_LARGE_FIXTURES}/scenarios"
    )
    set_target_properties(sce_c_integration_static_large PROPERTIES
        C_STANDARD 11
        C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON
        C_EXTENSIONS OFF
    )
    add_test(NAME c11_integration_static_large
        COMMAND sce_c_integration_static_large
    )
    set_tests_properties(c11_integration_static_large PROPERTIES
        TIMEOUT 120
        LABELS "integration;c11;aot"
    )

    # The saved-state tests compare what a machine writes with the shared text every backend writes,
    # deadlines included, so each runs on a manual clock. They link `integration/no_wall_clock.c` in
    # place of `sce_c_runtime_posix`: a machine that reads the wall clock stops at its first reading,
    # every run, instead of saving a deadline a millisecond short on a loaded machine now and then.
    add_library(sce_c_test_no_wall_clock STATIC integration/no_wall_clock.c)
    set_target_properties(sce_c_test_no_wall_clock PROPERTIES
        C_STANDARD 11
        C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON
        C_EXTENSIONS OFF
    )

    # One saved-state test: the executable `sce_c_integration_<name>`, registered as
    # `c11_integration_<name>`, with the directory of its shared texts defined as FIXTURES_DEFINE.
    # Every saved-state test is registered here, so none links a clock it could read.
    function(sce_c_add_saved_state_test name)
        cmake_parse_arguments(PARSE_ARGV 1 _saved "" "FIXTURES_DEFINE;FIXTURES_DIR" "SOURCES")
        set(_target sce_c_integration_${name})
        add_executable(${_target} ${_saved_SOURCES})
        # The manual clock implements `clock` for every machine the test
        # compiles; anything else they require is linked from the runtime.
        target_link_libraries(${_target} PRIVATE sce_c_test_no_wall_clock)
        sce_c_link_runtime(${_target} PROVIDES clock)
        target_include_directories(${_target} PRIVATE
            "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}"
            "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/backends/c/forge-runtime/include"
        )
        target_compile_definitions(${_target} PRIVATE
            "${_saved_FIXTURES_DEFINE}=\"${_saved_FIXTURES_DIR}\""
        )
        set_target_properties(${_target} PROPERTIES
            C_STANDARD 11
            C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON
            C_EXTENSIONS OFF
        )
        add_test(NAME c11_integration_${name}
            COMMAND ${_target}
        )
        set_tests_properties(c11_integration_${name} PROPERTIES
            TIMEOUT 30
            LABELS "integration;c11;aot"
        )
    endfunction()

    # Saving a machine and restoring it (SCE Accepted Subset §2.15, docs/adr/0045): every shared

    # surviving a restore, and a state that is not the document's refused. The machines are
    # generated above.

    )

    # The standard host features (docs/SCE_HOST_FEATURES.md): the scenarios of
    # tests/host_features/scenarios replayed against the generated machines that ask
    # for each feature, through the reference host of backends/c/host-features.
    #
    # The reference host is compiled into this executable and not linked as a
    # library: a result record travels in one data slot of the machine
    # (`SCE_MAX_DATA_LEN`) and the host registers every standard type
    # (`SCE_MAX_HOST_INVOKERS`), and both are layout the machine and the host must
    # agree on, so one target's definitions reach both.
    foreach(_HOST_FEATURE_MACHINE static_host_kv static_host_clock static_host_notify static_host_http static_host_model)

        )
    endforeach()
    # The reference harness (docs/adr/0087, section 6), with the documents it imports
    # beside it, and its two text templates, whose headers the machine includes and
    # does not generate, as static_render's template is generated above.
    sce_generate_static_integration_c_test(static_model_harness
        "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}"
        SCXML_FILE "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/sce-build/tests/fixtures/static_datamodel/static_model_harness.scxml"

                   harness_offer.scxml harness_start.scxml harness_ask.scxml harness_repair.scxml
    )

            "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/sce-build/tests/fixtures/static_datamodel/${_HARNESS_TEMPLATE}.scxml")
        list(APPEND _HARNESS_TEMPLATE_HEADERS ${_HARNESS_TEMPLATE_ONE_HEADERS})
    endforeach()

        integration/test_host_features.c

        "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/backends/c/host-features/include"

    # An `<invoke type="scxml">` of a `datamodel="sce-static"` machine: the

    # W3C SCXML 3.2: the resume seam — what `_init_at` accepts and what it
    # refuses. Not a fixture stem: it drives the two machines above rather than
    # adding a document of its own, because the claim is about a runtime door
    # and not about a topology. Both machines are here on purpose — the
    # parallel one is where the region rules and the datamodel declaration are,
    # the native-action one is where this backend's own extra refusal is (a

    # §scxml-6.4.1: the invoke half of the host seam, from the document the
    # C++, Rust, Go, Python and Kotlin channels drive. HOST_INVOKER rather than
    # HOST_PROCESSOR because they are separate contracts, and load-bearing for
    # the same reason: codegen decides at compile time whether the invoke
    # starts or refuses.
    sce_generate_static_integration_c_test(statechart_host_invoker
        "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}"
        SCXML_FILE "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/sce-build/tests/fixtures/host_processor/statechart_host_invoker.scxml"
        HOST_INVOKER x-sce-host
        # `perm`'s request and result records (`sce:request`, `sce:result`),
        # imported beside the fixture.
        STAGE_ALSO host_invoker_perm_request.scxml host_invoker_perm_result.scxml
    )
    add_executable(sce_c_integration_host_invoker
        integration/test_host_invoker.c
        ${INTEGRATION_C_TEST_statechart_host_invoker_SOURCES}
    )
    sce_c_link_runtime(sce_c_integration_host_invoker)
    target_include_directories(sce_c_integration_host_invoker PRIVATE
        "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}"
    )
    # The deadline grammar every runtime shares is held to one table, read by
    # this test from the checkout.
    target_compile_definitions(sce_c_integration_host_invoker PRIVATE
        SCE_HOST_INVOKE_DEADLINE_TABLE="${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/sce-build/tests/fixtures/host_processor/host_invoke_deadline_values.json"
    )
    set_target_properties(sce_c_integration_host_invoker PROPERTIES
        C_STANDARD 11
        C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON
        C_EXTENSIONS OFF
    )
    add_test(NAME c11_integration_host_invoker
        COMMAND sce_c_integration_host_invoker
    )
    set_tests_properties(c11_integration_host_invoker PROPERTIES
        TIMEOUT 30
        LABELS "integration;c11;aot"
    )

    # docs/adr/0084, ARCHITECTURE.md "Engine Threading": what another thread posts
    # to a generated machine enters through its inbox, bounded at the capacity the
    # deployment declares (`SCE_MAX_INBOX`), and is taken as a single-threaded
    # replay of the same posts takes it. The document the C++ engine's inbox test
    # drives, generated with the host-invoker declaration it is compiled with
    # there. Built once per row of the queue, as a deployment states its atomics
    # (`SCE_INBOX_ATOMIC_RMW_WIDTH`): the SCQ over 64- and over 32-bit entries
    # against the hosted reference atomics, and the interrupt-masked ring against
    # the hosted stand-in for masking interrupts, the two the forge runtime's own
    # queue tests run against. Beside it, the tree of `static_invoke_ending_order`
    # (generated above), whose host posts a child's ending inside the parent's
    # macrostep.
    find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
    sce_generate_static_integration_c_test(inbox_probe
        "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}"
        SCXML_FILE "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/integration/inbox_probe.scxml"
        HOST_INVOKER x-sce-host
    )
    foreach(_sce_inbox_width 64 32 0)
        set(_sce_inbox_target sce_c_integration_what_another_thread_posts_enters_through_the_inbox_${_sce_inbox_width})
        if(_sce_inbox_width EQUAL 0)
            set(_sce_inbox_platform "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/backends/c/forge-runtime/tests/conformance/sce_irq_host.c")
        else()
            set(_sce_inbox_platform "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/backends/c/forge-runtime/tests/conformance/sce_atomic_host.c")
        endif()
        add_executable(${_sce_inbox_target}
            integration/test_what_another_thread_posts_enters_through_the_inbox.c
            ${INTEGRATION_C_TEST_inbox_probe_SOURCES}
            ${INTEGRATION_C_TEST_static_invoke_ending_order_SOURCES}
            ${_sce_inbox_platform}
        )
        sce_c_link_runtime(${_sce_inbox_target})
        # The driver's own posting threads.
        target_link_libraries(${_sce_inbox_target} PRIVATE Threads::Threads)
        target_include_directories(${_sce_inbox_target} PRIVATE
            "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}"
            "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/backends/c/forge-runtime/include"
        )
        # The deployment's declaration: sixteen inputs, on this row.
        target_compile_definitions(${_sce_inbox_target} PRIVATE
            SCE_MAX_INBOX=16
            SCE_INBOX_ATOMIC_RMW_WIDTH=${_sce_inbox_width}
        )
        set_target_properties(${_sce_inbox_target} PROPERTIES
            C_STANDARD 11
            C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON
            C_EXTENSIONS OFF
        )
        add_test(NAME c11_integration_what_another_thread_posts_enters_through_the_inbox_${_sce_inbox_width}
            COMMAND ${_sce_inbox_target}
        )
        set_tests_properties(c11_integration_what_another_thread_posts_enters_through_the_inbox_${_sce_inbox_width}
            PROPERTIES
            TIMEOUT 60
            LABELS "integration;c11;aot"
        )
    endforeach()

    # The AI supervision loop — the sixth and last channel of the worked
    # example at examples/ai_loop/ai_loop.scxml.
    #
    # Named through SCXML_FILE for the reason the two registrations above give:
    # the input is a worked EXAMPLE rather than a stem under
    # `integration_resources/`, so nothing enumerates it. The C++ channel is
    # registered the same way in `tests/CMakeLists.txt`; the Rust, Go, Kotlin
    # and Python ones have per-stem regen scripts because their trees are
    # written to disk, and this backend generates into the build tree instead.
    # `sce-build/tests/ai_loop_channel_parity.rs` reads this file as this
    # channel's generator and holds all six to one scenario set.
    #
    # HOST_PROCESSOR is load-bearing, not decoration: the document declares its
    # acts as sends the host serves (W3C SCXML 6.2.5), and codegen decides at
    # compile time whether such a site dispatches or refuses. Without it every
    # act would raise `error.execution` and the driver would be measuring the
    # refusal.
    sce_generate_static_integration_c_test(ai_loop "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}"
        SCXML_FILE "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/examples/ai_loop/ai_loop.scxml"
        HOST_PROCESSOR x-sce-host
    )

        integration/test_ai_loop.c
        ${INTEGRATION_C_TEST_ai_loop_SOURCES}
    )
    # WITH the script engine: this document's prompts, budget and standing
    # rules are datamodel values and its guards read them, so the machine owns
    # a lua_State — unlike `sce_c_integration_native_action`, whose every
    # effect is native and whose link is the proof it needs none.
    sce_c_link_runtime(sce_c_integration_ai_loop)
    target_include_directories(sce_c_integration_ai_loop PRIVATE
        "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}"

    # §scxml-6.4.3: an <invoke> <param> gives a declared <data> of the invoked

    # both halves — lua_xfer_top_to_child moves the value across the two Lua

    add_test(NAME c11_integration_invoke_param_seeds_declared_child_data
        COMMAND sce_c_integration_invoke_param_seeds_declared_child_data
    )
    set_tests_properties(c11_integration_invoke_param_seeds_declared_child_data PROPERTIES
        TIMEOUT 30
        LABELS "integration;c11;aot"
    )

    # §scxml-5.7.1 under §scxml-6.4: a `<param>` of an `<invoke>` whose
    # expression will not evaluate. 6.4.2 terminates the element when "the
    # evaluation of its arguments produces an error"; 5.7.1 reports the failure
    # and ignores the name and value, and delegates only the SUCCESSFUL name and
    # value to the context — naming `<invoke>` in that sentence, so it is 5.7.1
    # that governs. This backend's arm popped the Lua error object and moved on,
    # so the child came up with a `<data>` nothing explained.
    sce_generate_static_integration_c_test(invoke_param_error_starts_the_child "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}")

    add_executable(sce_c_integration_invoke_param_error_starts_the_child
        integration/test_invoke_param_error_starts_the_child.c
        ${INTEGRATION_C_TEST_invoke_param_error_starts_the_child_SOURCES}
    )
    sce_c_link_runtime(sce_c_integration_invoke_param_error_starts_the_child)
    target_include_directories(sce_c_integration_invoke_param_error_starts_the_child PRIVATE
        "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}"
    )
    set_target_properties(sce_c_integration_invoke_param_error_starts_the_child PROPERTIES
        C_STANDARD 11
        C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON
        C_EXTENSIONS OFF
    )
    add_test(NAME c11_integration_invoke_param_error_starts_the_child
        COMMAND sce_c_integration_invoke_param_error_starts_the_child
    )
    set_tests_properties(c11_integration_invoke_param_error_starts_the_child PROPERTIES
        TIMEOUT 30
        LABELS "integration;c11;aot"
    )

    # §scxml-6.5.2: an EMPTY `<finalize>` means the automatic data-model update
    # — "for each item in the 'namelist' attribute and each such <param>
    # element, the Processor MUST update the corresponding location as if by
    # <assign>" — and an absent one means the opposite: "the automatic update
    # does not take place if the <finalize> element is absent as opposed to
    # empty". The corpus holds two `<finalize>` documents (W3C 233/234) and zero
    # empty ones, so the clause had no witness, and `finalize_content` being one
    # string meant it had no implementation either.
    sce_generate_static_integration_c_test(empty_finalize_updates_the_location "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}")

    add_executable(sce_c_integration_empty_finalize_updates_the_location
        integration/test_empty_finalize_updates_the_location.c
        ${INTEGRATION_C_TEST_empty_finalize_updates_the_location_SOURCES}
    )
    sce_c_link_runtime(sce_c_integration_empty_finalize_updates_the_location)
    target_include_directories(sce_c_integration_empty_finalize_updates_the_location PRIVATE
        "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}"
    )
    set_target_properties(sce_c_integration_empty_finalize_updates_the_location PROPERTIES
        C_STANDARD 11
        C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON
        C_EXTENSIONS OFF
    )
    add_test(NAME c11_integration_empty_finalize_updates_the_location
        COMMAND sce_c_integration_empty_finalize_updates_the_location
    )
    set_tests_properties(c11_integration_empty_finalize_updates_the_location PROPERTIES
        TIMEOUT 40
        LABELS "integration;c11;aot"
    )

    # §scxml-D-mainEventLoop: the preliminary <finalize> / autoforward step is
    # owed to the external event, not to the queue it arrived on. The four
    # autoforward_* fixtures above all let the machine forward events it queued
    # for itself, so every one of them drives the engine through its drain and
    # none can see a step that runs at one door and not another. This one hands
    # the machine an event from outside, through the host-facing entry point.
    sce_generate_static_integration_c_test(host_event_reaches_the_child "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}")

    add_executable(sce_c_integration_host_event_reaches_the_child
        integration/test_host_event_reaches_the_child.c
        ${INTEGRATION_C_TEST_host_event_reaches_the_child_SOURCES}
    )

    target_include_directories(sce_c_integration_host_event_reaches_the_child PRIVATE
        "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}"
    )
    set_target_properties(sce_c_integration_host_event_reaches_the_child PROPERTIES
        C_STANDARD 11
        C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON
        C_EXTENSIONS OFF
    )

        COMMAND sce_c_integration_host_event_reaches_the_child
    )
    set_tests_properties(c11_integration_host_event_reaches_the_child PROPERTIES
        TIMEOUT 30
        LABELS "integration;c11;aot"
    )

    # W3C SCXML C.1: the origin of a delivered event is the location the
    # sending session published for the SCXML Event I/O Processor, and that
    # location is a usable <send> target. The IRP suite checks neither half
    # across sessions — test336 and test350 both send to the session they
    # already are — so this fixture puts a peer session on the other end.
    sce_generate_static_integration_c_test(event_origin_is_a_location "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}")

    add_executable(sce_c_integration_event_origin_is_a_location

        ${INTEGRATION_C_TEST_event_origin_is_a_location_SOURCES}

    )

        TIMEOUT 30
        LABELS "integration;c11;aot"
    )

    # W3C SCXML 5.10: `_sessionid` is the id of a session, not of a document.
    # Two children run at once and report the id each was issued; a processor
    # that hands both the same value publishes one address for two sessions
    # (C.1.1), and a `<send>` to either reaches both. Every corpus test that
    # reaches `_sessionid` runs a single session, so none of them can ask.
    sce_generate_static_integration_c_test(session_ids_are_distinct "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}")

    add_executable(sce_c_integration_session_ids_are_distinct

    message(STATUS
        "skipping the c11 integration fixtures — their machines require the "
        "Lua engine and the platform clock, which SCE_C_RUNTIME_POSIX / "
        "SCE_ENABLE_LUA do not build in this configuration.")
endif()

# ─── forge buffer pool: RFC §synth-5-E slot FSM, exercised ──────────
#
# The pool header had no compile target anywhere in the tree — its only
# verification was a text grep over the emitted source, and a byte
# golden proves determinism rather than correctness. Compiling it is
# half the gap; the other half is that a header can compile and still
# hand out a slot twice. This target runs the FSM: acquire/return,
# free_count, payload round-trip, exhaustion, and the three separate
# guards on a bad handle (index, pool-state comparison, CPU-ownership
# tag) — each reached by a shape that the other two cannot reject, so
# no guard is vouched for by a sibling.
sce_c_integration_generation(_FP
    "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/forge/resources/buffer_pool_ast_export_min.scxml")

add_executable(sce_c_integration_forge_buffer_pool
    integration/test_forge_buffer_pool.c
    ${_FP_HEADERS}
)
target_include_directories(sce_c_integration_forge_buffer_pool PRIVATE
    "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}"
    "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/backends/c/forge-runtime/include"
    "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/backends/c/runtime/include"
)
# The pool is header-only `static inline` over file-scope storage, so
# there is no runtime library to link — the MCU single-TU premise, which
# the link holds: a generation that came to require one fails the configure.
sce_c_link_runtime(sce_c_integration_forge_buffer_pool EXCLUDES lua dom http clock)
target_compile_options(sce_c_integration_forge_buffer_pool PRIVATE
    -Wall -Wextra -Werror -Wpedantic
    -Wconversion -Wsign-conversion -Wshadow -Wcast-align
)
set_target_properties(sce_c_integration_forge_buffer_pool PROPERTIES
    C_STANDARD 11
    C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON
    C_EXTENSIONS OFF
)
add_test(NAME c11_integration_forge_buffer_pool
    COMMAND sce_c_integration_forge_buffer_pool
)
set_tests_properties(c11_integration_forge_buffer_pool PROPERTIES
    TIMEOUT 30
    LABELS "integration;c11;aot"
)

# ─── forge bounded collection: RFC §synth-5-D, exercised ────────────
#
# This one *was* compiled before — but only because an unrelated keyexpr
# fixture happens to emit a collection, so `c7_keyexpr_field_match`
# dragged it through a compiler as a side effect. That coverage vanishes
# the moment the keyexpr fixture changes, and it never covered behaviour.
#
# The property under test is the generation-tagged handle: a handle to a
# slot that has since been freed and *reused* must not resolve. A
# slot-index-only handle passes every simpler check and then silently
# addresses the wrong element.
#
# Three fixtures because the collection's element type is itself a forge
# document: `subscription_entry` (element) → `local_sub_table`
# (collection). The collection's header includes the element's, so the
# program compiles both generations' headers: what the generation of the
# collection reads, the element's document among it, is its depfile's.
set(_BC_FIXTURE_DIR "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/forge/resources")
sce_c_integration_generation(_BC_ENTRY "${_BC_FIXTURE_DIR}/subscription_entry.scxml")
sce_c_integration_generation(_BC_TABLE "${_BC_FIXTURE_DIR}/local_sub_table.scxml")

add_executable(sce_c_integration_forge_bounded_collection
    integration/test_forge_bounded_collection.c
    ${_BC_ENTRY_HEADERS}
    ${_BC_TABLE_HEADERS}
)
sce_c_link_runtime(sce_c_integration_forge_bounded_collection EXCLUDES lua dom http clock)
target_include_directories(sce_c_integration_forge_bounded_collection PRIVATE
    "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}"
    "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/backends/c/forge-runtime/include"
    "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/backends/c/runtime/include"
)
target_compile_options(sce_c_integration_forge_bounded_collection PRIVATE
    -Wall -Wextra -Werror -Wpedantic
    -Wconversion -Wsign-conversion -Wshadow -Wcast-align
)
set_target_properties(sce_c_integration_forge_bounded_collection PROPERTIES
    C_STANDARD 11
    C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON
    C_EXTENSIONS OFF
)
add_test(NAME c11_integration_forge_bounded_collection
    COMMAND sce_c_integration_forge_bounded_collection
)
set_tests_properties(c11_integration_forge_bounded_collection PROPERTIES
    TIMEOUT 30
    LABELS "integration;c11;aot"
)

# ─── test components: docs/SCE_TEST_PROFILE.md §12.3, §12.6 ────────
#
# The components of the runtime's end-to-end test, each the machine of its
# `test-component` document and the component the profile's runtime drives,
# generated beside the units of the records and templates they name, and run
# through `sce_test_case_run_t` against configurations and a system adapter
# written by hand (integration/test_a_test_component_runs_through_its_doors.c,
# the twin of the C++ ATestComponentRunsThroughItsDoorsTest). `param_asker`,
# whose module parameter a suite gives, is generated with the suite below. A
# component's machine runs on the logical clock of its run, so the program
# links no platform clock, no script engine and no HTTP client: a generation
# that came to require one fails the configure.
set(_TC_FIXTURE_DIR "${_TP_FIXTURE_DIR}/runtime")
set(_TC_HEADERS "")
set(_TC_SOURCES "")
foreach(_TC_DOCUMENT job_request job_reply request_of reply_ok reply_of any_request
                     asker coordinator answerer ptc_keeper idler)
    sce_c_integration_generation(_TC_${_TC_DOCUMENT} "${_TC_FIXTURE_DIR}/${_TC_DOCUMENT}.scxml"
        INPUT_ROOT "${_TC_FIXTURE_DIR}")
    list(APPEND _TC_HEADERS ${_TC_${_TC_DOCUMENT}_HEADERS})
    list(APPEND _TC_SOURCES ${_TC_${_TC_DOCUMENT}_SOURCES})
endforeach()

add_executable(sce_c_integration_a_test_component_runs_through_its_doors
    integration/test_a_test_component_runs_through_its_doors.c
    ${_TC_SOURCES}
    ${_TC_HEADERS}
)
target_include_directories(sce_c_integration_a_test_component_runs_through_its_doors PRIVATE
    "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}"
    "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/backends/c/forge-runtime/include"
    "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/backends/c/runtime/include"
)
sce_c_link_runtime(sce_c_integration_a_test_component_runs_through_its_doors EXCLUDES lua dom http clock)
# The saved value readers the runtime's module parameters are read through.
target_link_libraries(sce_c_integration_a_test_component_runs_through_its_doors PRIVATE m)
target_compile_options(sce_c_integration_a_test_component_runs_through_its_doors PRIVATE
    -Wall -Wextra -Werror -Wpedantic
    -Wconversion -Wsign-conversion -Wshadow -Wcast-align
)
set_target_properties(sce_c_integration_a_test_component_runs_through_its_doors PROPERTIES
    C_STANDARD 11
    C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON
    C_EXTENSIONS OFF
)

    COMMAND sce_c_integration_a_test_component_runs_through_its_doors

endforeach()

# ─── EventSchema native lowering fixture (NL→IR C1 Path A, RFC §10.4 step 5) ─
#
# Proves the C11 backend's native typed `_event.data` lowering at runtime
# (the downstream value path): a guard `_event.data.elapsed_ms === 0`
# lowers to a tagged-union comparison with NO script engine, and the typed
# inject seam `..._raise_external_typed` drives it. Generation runs directly
# from the read-only resource dir (NOT via the staging helper) so the
# `<sce:import kind="event-schema">` sibling resolves relative to the
# importing statechart's own directory.
#
# MCU-clean gate: the target links NO runtime library — the datamodel-less
# native path is fully self-contained (only header-only `sce/types.h`
# constants), so a successful link is the no-Lua / no-script-engine proof
# for a bare-metal target.
set(_ES_FIXTURE_ROOT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/integration_resources/event_schema_native")
sce_c_integration_generation(_ES "${_ES_FIXTURE_ROOT}/event_schema_native.scxml")

add_executable(sce_c_integration_event_schema_native
    integration/test_event_schema_native.c
    ${_ES_SOURCES}
    ${_ES_HEADERS}
)
sce_c_link_runtime(sce_c_integration_event_schema_native EXCLUDES lua dom)
# Intentionally NO target_link_libraries: the native value path links zero
# runtime — that is the MCU-clean acceptance proof (RFC §10.4 step 5).
target_include_directories(sce_c_integration_event_schema_native PRIVATE
    "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}"
    "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/backends/c/runtime/include"
)
set_target_properties(sce_c_integration_event_schema_native PROPERTIES
    C_STANDARD 11
    C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON
    C_EXTENSIONS OFF
)
add_test(NAME c11_integration_event_schema_native
    COMMAND sce_c_integration_event_schema_native
)
set_tests_properties(c11_integration_event_schema_native PROPERTIES
    TIMEOUT 30
    LABELS "integration;c11;aot"
)

# A 64-bit real in a typed payload, written into the event's `data` as
# ECMAScript spells it (ARCHITECTURE.md, "JSON Number Text"). The numeric twin
# above holds that a guard reads the payload; this holds the text the inject seam
# writes, which the machine reads back by `strtod` and so cannot tell from
# seventeen digits. Same MCU-clean contract: no runtime library is linked, and
# only the runtime's own include directory is on the path, so a writer that
# needed a header outside it would not build.
set(_ESR_FIXTURE_ROOT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/integration_resources/event_schema_real")
sce_c_integration_generation(_ESR "${_ESR_FIXTURE_ROOT}/event_schema_real.scxml")

add_executable(sce_c_integration_event_schema_real
