    ${_ESR_SOURCES}
    ${_ESR_HEADERS}
)
sce_c_link_runtime(sce_c_integration_event_schema_real EXCLUDES lua dom)
target_include_directories(sce_c_integration_event_schema_real PRIVATE
    "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}"
    "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/backends/c/runtime/include"
)
target_compile_definitions(sce_c_integration_event_schema_real PRIVATE
    SCE_JSON_REAL_TEXT_TABLE="${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/json_text/real_text.json")
set_target_properties(sce_c_integration_event_schema_real PROPERTIES
    C_STANDARD 11
    C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON
    C_EXTENSIONS OFF
)
add_test(NAME c11_integration_event_schema_real
    COMMAND sce_c_integration_event_schema_real
)
set_tests_properties(c11_integration_event_schema_real PROPERTIES
    TIMEOUT 30
    LABELS "integration;c11;aot"
)

# RFC rfc-eventschema-bytes-guard.md §6 — bytes-field twin of the numeric
# gate above. Same MCU-clean contract: the no-alloc bounded-buffer + memcmp
# value path links NO runtime library, so a successful link is the
# no-Lua / no-script-engine proof. The driver runs the guard
# (raw == "ack" → done / raw == "no" → waiting).
set(_ESB_FIXTURE_ROOT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/integration_resources/event_schema_bytes")
sce_c_integration_generation(_ESB "${_ESB_FIXTURE_ROOT}/event_schema_bytes.scxml")

add_executable(sce_c_integration_event_schema_bytes
    integration/test_event_schema_bytes.c
    ${_ESB_SOURCES}
    ${_ESB_HEADERS}
)
sce_c_link_runtime(sce_c_integration_event_schema_bytes EXCLUDES lua dom)
# Intentionally NO target_link_libraries: same MCU-clean acceptance proof.
target_include_directories(sce_c_integration_event_schema_bytes PRIVATE
    "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}"
    "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/backends/c/runtime/include"
)
set_target_properties(sce_c_integration_event_schema_bytes PROPERTIES
    C_STANDARD 11
    C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON
    C_EXTENSIONS OFF
)
add_test(NAME c11_integration_event_schema_bytes
    COMMAND sce_c_integration_event_schema_bytes
)
set_tests_properties(c11_integration_event_schema_bytes PROPERTIES
    TIMEOUT 30
    LABELS "integration;c11;aot"
)

# ─── EventSchema lifted-payload fixture (NL→IR C1 Path A) ───────────
#
# The two gates above drive the typed payload through the generated inject
# seam. This one drives the OTHER carrier: the event record's `data`, which is
# what every producer except that seam fills — `<send>` with `<param>`, an
# invoke forwarding an event either way, autoforward, BasicHTTP, mesh. Until
# 2026-09-22 a natively lowered guard could read nothing but the typed union,
# so the same guard answered differently depending on where its event came
# from. Its `error.execution` transition makes a payload that does not read as
# its schema observable with no script engine to ask.
#
# ⚠ The fixture is the CANONICAL one under sce-build/tests/fixtures, not a
# third copy beside this file: `--input-root` resolves the `<sce:import
# kind="event-schema">` sibling next to the importing statechart, which is the
# same choice the Rust, Go, Kotlin and Python gates make.
#
# MCU-clean gate, unchanged by the lift: this target links NO runtime library.
# `sce/event_payload.h` is header-only for exactly that reason.
set(_ESL_FIXTURE_ROOT "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/sce-build/tests/fixtures/event_schema")
sce_c_integration_generation(_ESL "${_ESL_FIXTURE_ROOT}/statechart_lifted.scxml"
    INPUT_ROOT "${_ESL_FIXTURE_ROOT}")

add_executable(sce_c_integration_event_schema_lifted
    integration/test_event_schema_lifted.c
    ${_ESL_SOURCES}
    ${_ESL_HEADERS}
)
sce_c_link_runtime(sce_c_integration_event_schema_lifted EXCLUDES lua dom)
# Intentionally NO target_link_libraries: same MCU-clean acceptance proof.
target_include_directories(sce_c_integration_event_schema_lifted PRIVATE
    "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}"
    "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/backends/c/runtime/include"
)
set_target_properties(sce_c_integration_event_schema_lifted PROPERTIES
    C_STANDARD 11
    C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON
    C_EXTENSIONS OFF
)
add_test(NAME c11_integration_event_schema_lifted
    COMMAND sce_c_integration_event_schema_lifted
)
set_tests_properties(c11_integration_event_schema_lifted PROPERTIES
    TIMEOUT 30
    LABELS "integration;c11;aot"
)

# ─── BasicHTTP fixture: standalone Node server lifecycle ────────────
#
# The W3C SCXML C.2 corpus addresses `http://localhost:8080/test` on the
# fixture-side and expects a server to echo events back. The cpp side's
# `w3c_test_cli` runs the same expectation via in-process orchestration
# (`tests/w3c/standalone_http_server.js` spawned by the WASM polyfill;
# native cpp uses the in-process httplib server). C11 fixtures run as
# bare ctest executables with no orchestrator, so without this ctest
# FIXTURES_SETUP every `w3c_c_aot_<N>` test of the registry's `http` harness
# would hit a dead socket and time out in `sce_test_http_post`.
#
# The setup arm launches `node tests/w3c/standalone_http_server.js
# 8080 /test`, waits for the `[READY]` line on stdout (capped at 5s),
# and records the pid. The cleanup arm reads the pid and SIGTERMs it
# (KILL fallback after 2s). Both arms are idempotent so a partial-run
# `ctest -R w3c_c_aot_513` followed by another ctest invocation does
# not stack server instances.
# W3C_C_AOT_HTTP_TESTS holds the runners the loop above scheduled with the
# `http` harness, so a configuration that schedules none (a bare-metal one, or
# one whose script engine those machines need is not built) registers no server
# fixture that no test can require: inert, since ctest starts a fixture only on
# demand, but it reads in `ctest -N` as coverage that is not there.
if(W3C_C_AOT_HTTP_TESTS)
    find_program(SCE_TEST_NODE_EXECUTABLE node)
    if(SCE_TEST_NODE_EXECUTABLE)
        set(_http_fixture_pid "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/w3c_http_server.pid")
        set(_http_fixture_sh "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/w3c/http_server_fixture.sh")
        set(_http_server_js "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/w3c/standalone_http_server.js")

        # The endpoint comes from the top-level SCE_W3C_HTTP_PORT/PATH, which
        # read their defaults out of tests/w3c/basic_http_test_endpoint.h --
        # the header the runners themselves include. One fact, so the address
        # this binds is the address they publish.
        add_test(NAME w3c_c_http_server_setup
            COMMAND bash "${_http_fixture_sh}" start
                "${SCE_TEST_NODE_EXECUTABLE}" "${_http_server_js}"
                "${SCE_W3C_HTTP_PORT}" "${SCE_W3C_HTTP_PATH}" "${_http_fixture_pid}"
        )
        set_tests_properties(w3c_c_http_server_setup PROPERTIES
            FIXTURES_SETUP w3c_c_http_server
            TIMEOUT 15
            LABELS "w3c;c11;aot;fixture"
        )

        add_test(NAME w3c_c_http_server_cleanup
            COMMAND bash "${_http_fixture_sh}" stop "${_http_fixture_pid}"
        )
        set_tests_properties(w3c_c_http_server_cleanup PROPERTIES
            FIXTURES_CLEANUP w3c_c_http_server
            TIMEOUT 10
            LABELS "w3c;c11;aot;fixture"
        )
    else()
        string(REPLACE ";" "|" _http_test_alternatives "${W3C_C_AOT_HTTP_TESTS}")
        message(WARNING
            "node not found on PATH; W3C SCXML C.2 BasicHTTP fixtures "
            "(${W3C_C_AOT_HTTP_TESTS}) will time out at runtime. "
            "Install Node.js or use ctest -E 'w3c_c_aot_(${_http_test_alternatives})$' "
            "to skip.")
    endif()
endif()

# sce_c_scripting carries the lua_dom binding this suite reads through,
# and it is built only under SCE_ENABLE_LUA.
if(SCE_ENABLE_LUA)
    # ─── DOM helper unit tests ──────────────────────────────────────────
    #
    # Coverage for the full pugixml feature set (DOCTYPE / CDATA / entity
    # decoding / mixed text PCDATA) that the W3C SCXML B.2 corpus does not
    # force. Without these the additions to backends/c/tests/support/dom.c are
    # unconsumed; the unit suite is the first reader and pins the parser's
    # `parse_default`-equivalent behaviour against drift.
    add_executable(sce_c_dom_unit_test unit/dom_test.c)
    target_link_libraries(sce_c_dom_unit_test PRIVATE sce_c_runtime sce_c_base sce_c_scripting)
    set_target_properties(sce_c_dom_unit_test PROPERTIES
        C_STANDARD 11
        C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON
        C_EXTENSIONS OFF
    )
    add_test(NAME c11_unit_dom COMMAND sce_c_dom_unit_test)
    set_tests_properties(c11_unit_dom PROPERTIES
        TIMEOUT 10
        LABELS "unit;c11"
    )
else()
    message(STATUS
        "skipping c11_unit_dom — it links sce_c_scripting, which "
        "SCE_ENABLE_LUA does not build in this configuration.")
endif()

# Linked against the POSIX platform impl (the client under test) and
# sce_c_scripting (the http_lua binding), so this binary exists only
# when both are built.
if(SCE_C_RUNTIME_POSIX AND SCE_ENABLE_LUA)
    # ─── HTTP client unit tests ────────────────────────────────────────
    #
    # Coverage for the host-side HTTP/1.1 client + JSON response extractor
    # (backends/c/tests/support/http_client.{c,h}). The W3C SCXML C.2 corpus
    # only exercises the happy path against the standalone Node server;
    # these unit tests force edge cases the corpus does not (URL parsing
    # rejections, percent-encoding overflow, depth-counted JSON object
    # capture with embedded `}`, `\uXXXX` UTF-8 unescape) plus a single
    # end-to-end POST round-trip against an in-process loopback server
    # (TCP 127.0.0.1, OS-assigned port, single-shot accept thread). pthread
    # link is local to this binary — sce_c_test_http_support stays free of
    # threading deps so fixture binaries that only call the synchronous
    # POST API do not pull pthread either.
    find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
    add_executable(sce_c_http_client_unit_test unit/http_client_test.c)
    target_link_libraries(sce_c_http_client_unit_test
        PRIVATE
            sce_c_runtime
            sce_c_runtime_posix
            sce_c_scripting
            Threads::Threads
    )
    set_target_properties(sce_c_http_client_unit_test PROPERTIES
        C_STANDARD 11
        C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON
        C_EXTENSIONS OFF
    )
    add_test(NAME c11_unit_http_client COMMAND sce_c_http_client_unit_test)
    set_tests_properties(c11_unit_http_client PROPERTIES
        TIMEOUT 30
        LABELS "unit;c11"
        # In-process loopback pthread server with a 5s client recv timeout —
        # CPU-heavy peers under `ctest -j` starve scheduling and flake the
        # bound. Force serial so the round-trip runs unimpeded.
        RUN_SERIAL TRUE
    )
else()
    message(STATUS
        "skipping c11_unit_http_client — it links sce_c_runtime_posix "
        "and sce_c_scripting, which SCE_C_RUNTIME_POSIX / SCE_ENABLE_LUA "
        "do not build in this configuration.")
endif()

# ─── Payload bytes unit test ────────────────────────────────────────
#
# How a byte string rides in a typed payload (docs/adr/0005, decision 2): its
# byte-exact Latin-1 text, read the same whether a producer escapes what is not
# ASCII or writes the characters as they are, with a character past U+00FF refused.
# Header-only code, so the test needs nothing a configuration can leave out.
add_executable(sce_c_payload_bytes_unit_test unit/payload_bytes_test.c)
target_link_libraries(sce_c_payload_bytes_unit_test PRIVATE sce_c_runtime)
set_target_properties(sce_c_payload_bytes_unit_test PROPERTIES
    C_STANDARD 11
    C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON
    C_EXTENSIONS OFF
)
add_test(NAME c11_unit_payload_bytes COMMAND sce_c_payload_bytes_unit_test)
set_tests_properties(c11_unit_payload_bytes PROPERTIES
    TIMEOUT 10
    LABELS "unit;c11"
)

# ─── Payload refusal unit test ──────────────────────────────────────
#
# What the payload reader refuses and how it names the refusal (docs/adr/0087,
# sections 2.3 and 2.4): the code, the RFC 6901 pointer and the bound of every case
# of tests/json_text/payload_refusal.json, the table every runtime's reader reads,
# and the codes held to the enum stdlib/lift/refusal_code.scxml declares.
# Header-only code, so the test needs nothing a configuration can leave out.
add_executable(sce_c_payload_refusal_unit_test unit/payload_refusal_test.c)
target_link_libraries(sce_c_payload_refusal_unit_test PRIVATE sce_c_runtime)
target_compile_definitions(sce_c_payload_refusal_unit_test PRIVATE
    SCE_JSON_PAYLOAD_REFUSAL_TABLE="${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/json_text/payload_refusal.json"
    SCE_STDLIB_REFUSAL_CODE="${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/stdlib/lift/refusal_code.scxml")
set_target_properties(sce_c_payload_refusal_unit_test PROPERTIES
    C_STANDARD 11
    C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON
    C_EXTENSIONS OFF
)
add_test(NAME c11_unit_payload_refusal COMMAND sce_c_payload_refusal_unit_test)
set_tests_properties(c11_unit_payload_refusal PROPERTIES
    TIMEOUT 10
    LABELS "unit;c11"
)

# ─── Payload composed unit test ─────────────────────────────────────
#
# A value of any bounded type at its path (docs/adr/0086): the list cursor and the
# record view of `sce/event_payload.h` over every element kind at three depths, the
# nested containers of the wire writer, and the bounded list of
# `sce/forge/bounded_list.h`. Header-only code.
add_executable(sce_c_payload_composed_unit_test unit/payload_composed_test.c)

    "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/backends/c/forge-runtime/include")
set_target_properties(sce_c_payload_composed_unit_test PROPERTIES
    C_STANDARD 11
    C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON
    C_EXTENSIONS OFF
)
add_test(NAME c11_unit_payload_composed COMMAND sce_c_payload_composed_unit_test)
set_tests_properties(c11_unit_payload_composed PROPERTIES
    TIMEOUT 10
    LABELS "unit;c11"
)

# ─── C++ consumption gate ───────────────────────────────────────────
#
# Every header the C11 backend publishes (`backends/c/runtime/include/sce`,
# `backends/c/forge-runtime/include/sce/forge`) and every header it
# generates opens `#ifdef __cplusplus extern "C"`. That is a contract
# with C++ consumers — an AP-side application links the same generated
# machine an MCU compiles — and nothing checked it until this gate.
#
# It was not being met. `_Static_assert` is a C11 keyword with no C++
# spelling, and it appeared in `sce/sample.h` and in every generated
# `_sm.h`, so a C++ translation unit including any of them failed to
# parse. GCC rejected them; Clang accepted them as an extension and
# rejected them again under `-Werror`. The headers are now written
# through `SCE_STATIC_ASSERT` (`sce/portability.h`), and this gate is
# what keeps them that way — a fix without it regresses the first time
# someone writes the keyword back.
#
# The gate scans directories at test time rather than taking a
# registered file list, so a header added later is covered without
# anyone remembering to add it, and a root that resolves to zero
# headers fails rather than passing over an empty set.
#
# That last property is why the W3C tree is named conditionally. Nothing
# consumes its codegen when the runners are not built, so ninja never
# runs it and the directory stays empty — which the gate reports as a
# broken scan, correctly, because it cannot tell "nobody generated this"
# from "the scan lost its root". Naming only the trees this
# configuration populates keeps the floor meaningful instead of
# weakening it to tolerate emptiness.
set(_sce_cxx_scan_roots
    "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/backends/c/runtime/include/sce"
    "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/backends/c/forge-runtime/include/sce/forge"
    "${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}"
)
if(SCE_C_RUNTIME_POSIX)
    list(APPEND _sce_cxx_scan_roots "${SCE_C_GENERATED_DIR}")
endif()
list(JOIN _sce_cxx_scan_roots "|" _sce_cxx_scan_roots)

add_test(NAME c11_headers_are_cxx_consumable
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND}
        -DSCE_CXX_COMPILER=${CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER}
        -DSCE_CXX_STANDARD=17
        -DSCE_SCAN_ROOTS=${_sce_cxx_scan_roots}
        -DSCE_INCLUDE_DIRS=${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/backends/c/runtime/include|${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/backends/c/forge-runtime/include|${SCE_C_GENERATED_DIR}|${SCE_C_INTEGRATION_GENERATED_DIR}|${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/third_party/lua/src
        -DSCE_WORK_DIR=${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/cxx_consumption
        -P ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/cxx_consumption_gate.cmake
)
set_tests_properties(c11_headers_are_cxx_consumable PROPERTIES
    TIMEOUT 300
    LABELS "unit;c11"
)

# ============================================================
# A product line's machine for every build (docs/adr/0057 §6 and §10).
# ============================================================
#
# `tests/product_line/session.scxml` is generated once for every build of its
# feature model, its members under `#if` over the features' macros, and once
# for each feature set alone. The generator checks the first against the
# second token for token before it writes it; this hands the question to the
# compiler and to a run. One program per feature set compiles both machines
# with that set's `-D` and drives them through every run of up to four events:
# they must agree on everything a host observes of a machine. The symbol
# prefixes keep the two machines apart in one program.
#
# One more test compiles the machine for every build under a set the model
# does not admit (a feature without the one it requires), which its header
# refuses with an `#error`.
if(SCE_C_RUNTIME_POSIX)
    set(_SCE_PRODUCT_LINE "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/product_line")
    set(_SCE_FEATURE_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/feature_conformance")

    sce_codegen_generation(_SCE_FEATURE_LIFTED
        DOCUMENT "${_SCE_PRODUCT_LINE}/session.scxml"
        OUTPUT_DIR "${_SCE_FEATURE_DIR}/lifted"
        LANGUAGE c11
        INPUT_ROOT "${_SCE_PRODUCT_LINE}"
        ARGS --c-symbol-prefix lifted
        COMMENT "Generating the C11 machine for every build of tests/product_line/session.scxml")

    # Each feature set: its name, the features it turns on, and the macros a
    # build of it defines.
    set(_SCE_FEATURE_SETS none unicast accept)
    set(_SCE_FEATURES_none "")
    set(_SCE_FEATURES_unicast "session-unicast")
    set(_SCE_FEATURES_accept "session-unicast,session-unicast-accept")
    set(_SCE_DEFINES_none "")
    set(_SCE_DEFINES_unicast SCE_FEATURE_SESSION_UNICAST)
    set(_SCE_DEFINES_accept SCE_FEATURE_SESSION_UNICAST SCE_FEATURE_SESSION_UNICAST_ACCEPT)

    foreach(_SET ${_SCE_FEATURE_SETS})
        sce_codegen_generation(_SCE_FEATURE_ALONE_${_SET}
            DOCUMENT "${_SCE_PRODUCT_LINE}/session.scxml"
            OUTPUT_DIR "${_SCE_FEATURE_DIR}/${_SET}/alone"
            LANGUAGE c11
            INPUT_ROOT "${_SCE_PRODUCT_LINE}"
            ARGS "--features=${_SCE_FEATURES_${_SET}}" --c-symbol-prefix alone
            COMMENT "Generating the C11 machine of tests/product_line/session.scxml for `${_SET}`")

        add_executable(sce_c_feature_conformance_${_SET}
            integration/test_feature_conformance.c
            ${_SCE_FEATURE_LIFTED_SOURCES} ${_SCE_FEATURE_LIFTED_HEADERS}
            ${_SCE_FEATURE_ALONE_${_SET}_SOURCES} ${_SCE_FEATURE_ALONE_${_SET}_HEADERS}
        )
        target_compile_definitions(sce_c_feature_conformance_${_SET} PRIVATE
            ${_SCE_DEFINES_${_SET}}
        )
        # The program names each machine by its directory: `lifted/` beside
        # the feature sets' own, and `alone/` in this set's. An `sce-static`
        # machine reads the forge runtime's headers as well.
        target_include_directories(sce_c_feature_conformance_${_SET} PRIVATE
            "${_SCE_FEATURE_DIR}" "${_SCE_FEATURE_DIR}/${_SET}"
            "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/backends/c/forge-runtime/include"
        )
        sce_c_link_runtime(sce_c_feature_conformance_${_SET})
        set_target_properties(sce_c_feature_conformance_${_SET} PROPERTIES
            C_STANDARD 11
            C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON
            C_EXTENSIONS OFF
        )
        add_test(NAME c11_feature_conformance_${_SET}
            COMMAND sce_c_feature_conformance_${_SET}
        )
        set_tests_properties(c11_feature_conformance_${_SET} PROPERTIES
            TIMEOUT 120
            LABELS "integration;c11;aot"
        )
    endforeach()

    if(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "GNU|Clang")
        add_test(NAME c11_feature_conformance_refuses_a_broken_edge
            COMMAND ${CMAKE_C_COMPILER} -std=c11 -fsyntax-only
                    "-I$<JOIN:$<TARGET_PROPERTY:sce_c_runtime,INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES>,;-I>"
                    "-I${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/backends/c/forge-runtime/include"
                    -DSCE_FEATURE_SESSION_UNICAST_ACCEPT
                    ${_SCE_FEATURE_LIFTED_SOURCES}
            COMMAND_EXPAND_LISTS
        )
        # The compiler fails either way; the test is that it fails on the
        # model's refusal, which names the edge.
        set_tests_properties(c11_feature_conformance_refuses_a_broken_edge PROPERTIES
            TIMEOUT 60
            LABELS "integration;c11;aot"
            PASS_REGULAR_EXPRESSION "feature `session-unicast-accept` requires `session-unicast`"
        )
    endif()
endif()

# ============================================================
# Aggregate build target for the whole C11 test surface.
# ============================================================
#
# `ctest -L c11` runs 218 tests across 215 separate executables. Building
# them needs a target: `cmake --build build` with no target builds the
# entire project — the C++ engine, mesh, forge, the examples — which is
# most of the cost for a lane that only exercises the C backend, and the
# C backend links none of it (`sce_c_runtime` + `sce_c_runtime_posix`,
# plus lua54 / sce_c_base / sce_c_scripting where a fixture needs them).
#
# The dependency list is derived from the directory rather than written
# out. A hand-maintained list of 215 names would be wrong the first time
# someone adds a fixture and forgets it, and the failure mode is the one
# this whole lane exists to remove: the test is registered, the binary is
# never built, and the lane reports on a smaller set than its name
# claims. `BUILDSYSTEM_TARGETS` cannot omit a target defined here.
#
# Placed at the end of the file so every `add_executable` above it has
# already run — a target defined after this block would be missed, which
# is why nothing may be appended below.
get_property(_sce_c_test_targets DIRECTORY PROPERTY BUILDSYSTEM_TARGETS)
add_custom_target(sce_c11_tests
    COMMENT "Building the C11 test surface (ctest -L c11)"
)
foreach(_sce_c_target ${_sce_c_test_targets})
    if(NOT _sce_c_target STREQUAL sce_c11_tests)
        add_dependencies(sce_c11_tests ${_sce_c_target})
    endif()
endforeach()
list(LENGTH _sce_c_test_targets _sce_c_test_target_count)
message(STATUS "sce_c11_tests aggregates ${_sce_c_test_target_count} target(s)")
